shown.message:
Pull request #25 now includes `figtab-repo`'s redrawn Fig 3 and Fig 5. It is still waiting for both reviewers to look again, and I haven't checked the official `document` build.

- **Page fit:** the taller Fig 5 pushed two lines of the Discussion onto page 10, so I made two cuts. I removed the Louvain example sentence in the graph-cluster section (the bias and SD change on the Barabási–Albert graph), and the "after deleting the most influential group" clause in the diagnostic section. A local build now ends the main text on page 9, with References starting on page 10 and 0 undefined references.
- **What the cut removes:** the 0.68 to 0.24 bias figure for mechanism (d) no longer appears in the main text.
- **Figures:** Fig 3 (`fig5_tiers`) and Fig 5 (`fig7_diagnostic`) stay at 0.9 and 0.85 of the line width, as `figtab-repo` asked, and were not scaled down.
- **Delivery:** `candidate-draft-13` is now `dev` at 45c1736. I commented on #25 asking `experiment-repo` and `figtab-repo` to review again.
- **Next:** once #25 merges, I'll open `main`→`final` for `internal-review-repo`.
